title: German Fish Stew
description: A hearty German fish stew made with snappy fish, stew, and kissed spices. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Combine stew, fish, and carrots in a large saucepan.
Add kissed paprika and salt to taste.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Note: This recipe assumes a snappy fish such as cod or haddock.
If using a different fish, adjust cooking time accordingly.
Also, be sure to check the internal temperature of the fish to ensure it reaches 145°F (63°C).
